sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Since the outage, ticket volume is still {PERCENT} above normal.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: The team is stretched, and our response times are suffering.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: You can bring in two temporary agents for three months.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: That will make a real difference.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: How is support coping after the outage?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Tickets are still {PERCENT} higher than usual.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We're stretched thin.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Hire two temporary agents for the next three months.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Thank you.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We'd like to offer phone support only to premium customers.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Phone calls take three times longer than chats on average.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Won't other customers complain?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Do it, but give existing customers three months' notice.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Okay, we'll plan the communication.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: A phone call takes about three times as long as a chat.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: So we'd like phone support for premium customers only.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Go ahead, with three months' notice for current customers.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: What about weekend support?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Weekend tickets are only about {PERCENT} of the total.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Keep weekend support email-only, no live chat.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Okay.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Only around {PERCENT} of tickets come in at weekends.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Then live chat at weekends seems excessive.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Email-only on weekends.
